1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for oil and gas field applications__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein said composition provides controlled release of said multivalent cation crosslinker in a reservoir environment__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight in the range of 600 to 1800 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein said polyanion has a molecular weight greater than 10,000 Da__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said crosslinker is present in an amount effective to provide delayed gelation when combined with a crosslinkable polymer__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein said composition maintains stability in high salinity brines__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __wherein said nanoparticles are stable for at least 30 days in field brine__.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __at temperatures up to 150°C__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for controlled release applications in oil and gas operations__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, __wherein said multivalent cation is released in a controlled manner upon exposure to reservoir conditions__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __wherein said multivalent cation functions as a crosslinking agent for polymers used in enhanced oil recovery__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with __the multivalent cation crosslinker of__ a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __selected from partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, polyacrylic acid, or copolymers thereof__.

23) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis of 10-40%__.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein said polymer has a molecular weight of at least 1,000,000 Da__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __having a total dissolved solids content of at least 10,000 ppm__.
